SELECT
    to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fecha,
    COUNT(*)::int AS total_conversaciones
FROM conversations
WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date
      = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date;

SELECT
    to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fecha,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id = 3)::int  AS "Agente 3",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id = 4)::int  AS "Agente 4",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id = 6)::int  AS "Agente 6",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id = 1)::int  AS "Agente 1",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id = 2)::int  AS "Agente 2",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id = 5)::int  AS "Agente 5",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id = 99)::int  AS "agente n8n",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id IS NULL)::int AS "sin asignar",
    COUNT(*)::int AS "Total general"
FROM conversations
WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date
      = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date;

SELECT
    to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fecha,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 1 AND first_reply_created_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS cerradas_con_resp,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 1 AND first_reply_created_at IS NULL)::int     AS cerradas_sin_resp,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 2 AND first_reply_created_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS pendientes_con_resp,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 2 AND first_reply_created_at IS NULL)::int     AS pendientes_sin_resp
FROM conversations
WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date
      = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date - 1;

SELECT
    to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date - 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fecha,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 2)::int AS pendientes_total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 2 AND first_reply_created_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS pendientes_con_resp,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 2 AND first_reply_created_at IS NULL)::int     AS pendientes_sin_resp
FROM conversations
WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date
      = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date - 1;

SELECT
  to_char(
    (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date,
    'YYYY-MM-DD' 
  ) AS fecha,
  COUNT(*)::int AS entradas,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id = 99)::int AS resueltas_bot,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND assignee_id <> 26)::int AS escaladas_humano,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id IS NULL)::int AS sin_asignar,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_id = 99)::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    4
  ) AS cobertura_bot
FROM conversations
WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date
      = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date - 1
GROUP BY 1;

SELECT
  to_char(
    (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date,
    'YYYY-MM-DD'
  ) AS fecha,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE user_id = 99)::int AS cerradas_bot,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE user_id IN (3,7,4,6,1,2,5))::int AS cerradas_humano,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE user_id IS NULL)::int AS cerradas_sistema,
  COUNT(*)::int AS total_cierres
FROM reporting_events
WHERE name = 'conversation_resolved'
  AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date
      = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date - 1
GROUP BY 1;
